examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{保育園|ほいくえん}に{預|あず}けている。
examples.english: I leave my child at the nursery school.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}の{入園|にゅうえん}{申|もう}し{込|こ}みをした。
examples.english: I applied for admission to the nursery school.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}は{待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many children on waiting lists for nursery schools.

notes:
{保育園|ほいくえん} is primarily for childcare, typically for children ages 0-6, with longer hours than kindergarten.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}に{預|あず}ける (leave [child] at nursery)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}に{入|はい}れる (get into nursery school)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}に{通|かよ}う (attend nursery school)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}の{保育士|ほいくし} (nursery school teacher)
- {認可|にんか}{保育園|ほいくえん} (licensed nursery)

WAITLIST ISSUE:
In urban areas, {待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}{問題|もんだい} (waitlisted children problem) is a major social issue. Many families struggle to find nursery spots.

CONTRAST WITH {幼稚園|ようちえん}:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: For working parents, accepts infants (0+), long hours (7am-7pm)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}: Education-focused, ages 3+, shorter hours

definitions.gloss: nursery school, daycare center, childcare facility
